answer: The system grows a grove of linked proofs forming a trellis that binds every new AI identity to a shared vault of payment keys, timing signatures, or stake deposits; each link is recorded as a unique hash in an immutable ledger. An attacker must simultaneously forge the vault access, replicate the exact timing pattern and provide fresh stake for every fake node, which on a shale‑hard ledger costs linear resources proportional to the number of identities.
